text:
maria: Quick PR up for dedicated provisioning docs — migration guide + a new SDK snippet for tenant labels. Need quick QA before I merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482
kevin: Looking now. Which sections changed?
maria: Added an 'autoscale cooldown' example, clarified eviction vs preemption in the SLA section, included a Python SDK snippet showing tenant label usage, and fixed a broken handbook link.
sam: Two quick things: 1) the Python snippet uses a deprecated client call. 2) eviction wording might be read as preemption — we should make the difference explicit with an example of what triggers each.
lee: Product ask: add a short note on canary/fallback behavior for Dedicated. Customers expect an automatic fallback to compatible pools; document the config key 'fallback_policy: regional_compatible' and an example.
maria: Good call — I'll add that. Proposed YAML for fallback config:
```yaml
service: my-llm-service
provisioning:
  mode: dedicated
  fallback_policy: regional_compatible
  autoscale:
    cooldown_seconds: 60
    policy: target_utilization
```
kevin: For the Python SDK snippet, swap out the deprecated allocate_tenant call. Suggested replacement:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.environ["REDWOOD_KEY"])
# reserve capacity with labels
client.reserve_capacity(
    tenant_id="acme-prod",
    gpus=2,
    labels={"team": "search", "env": "prod"},
)
```
sam: Also add the isolation decorator example in the docs. Minimal example: 
```yaml
tenant_isolation: hard  # hard: strict node isolation, soft: shared with soft-guard rails
```
And a small SLA note: "SLA_adjusted = SLA_base - PreemptionPenalty" with PreemptionPenalty documented per-region. Keep the math informal.
dev-bot: link-checker: 1 broken link found -> 'handbook/onboarding.md#tenant-labels' should be 'handbook/onboarding.md#tenant-labeling' (automated suggestion applied to branch).
maria: Thanks all — I'll update the snippet and the eviction wording. Who wants to sanity-check the new 'eviction vs preemption' paragraph? I tried to write a short example but want to avoid legal overpromising.
lee: I can take wording pass. Sam, can you paste the SLA blurb into the PR comments and I'll fold it into product text?
sam: Done — left PR comment with the SLA blurb and a short test plan note for autoscale cooldown (staging test to simulate spike then cooldown).
kevin: LGTM once the SDK calls are switched. Maria — ping me after you push the snippet update and I will merge if tests pass.
maria: Updated the PR with the SDK change and YAML fallback example: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482/files. Running link-check and spellcheck. Merging after CI (expected in ~10m). /cc @kevin @lee :thumbsup:
